articles.title: Inside the FBI’s little-known annual crypto crime gathering
articles.snippet: The Virtual Asset Technical Exchange brings together investigators, law enforcement officials, and crypto-security specialists to exchange intelligence on a wide range of crimes involving digital assets.

articles.title: BitMEX shuts down: perpetuals pioneer officially closes it doors after 11 years
articles.snippet: The exchange, co-founded by Arthur Hayes, stopped trading and deposits, but says users can still log in and withdraw funds as its wind-down continues.

articles.title: Crypto market structure can't wait for shot at post-election Clarity Act surge: White House
articles.snippet: White House and U.S. Treasury officials agree that despite some hope that Congress' "lame duck" session could see the bill again, the work's in regulators' hands.

articles.title: US lawmakers from gaming states urge SCOTUS to take up Kalshi case
articles.snippet: The case between New Jersey authorities and a prediction market company, if accepted by the Supreme Court, could result in clarity for state and federal officials over sports bets.

articles.title: Raiffeisen to offer crypto trading across 11 European markets via Bitpanda
articles.snippet: Bitpanda will provide crypto infrastructure to Raiffeisen network banks, potentially extending digital asset access to about 18 million customers.
